audit_failure_plan: Stop execution, preserve local evidence, and require manual audit path review before any retry.
rollback_plan: Revoke the proposed window, keep network execution disabled, and return to offline fixtures only.
secret_exposure_rotation_plan: Immediately revoke the sandbox credential candidate, rotate externally, and invalidate any pending grant.
unauthorized_network_shutdown_plan: Disable the sandbox window, preserve audit evidence, and require egress owner review.
